description: Disconnect this assistant from the member's FirmLedger account. The sign-in is revoked on FirmLedger's side at once, and every token it issued stops working. Call it when the member asks to remove, sign out or disconnect their account. It cannot erase the token stored in the member's assistant app, so tell the member to remove the FirmLedger connector there as well.
name: revoke_connection
title: Remove the FirmLedger account connection
